dct_description_sm: To strengthen polar sciences, online databases have been developed to foster sharing between scientists and adequately curate research data. However, recent literature suggests that a majority of the scientific database projects failed, in part because of our poor understanding of the actual data sharing practices within the scientific communities. This research was undertaken to address the question of data sharing within scientific communities. We investigated the case of ArcticNet, a multidisciplinary scientific network dedicated to the study of climate change in coastal Canadian Arctic.
